name: storebase
description: Apps & Explore two-tab app packaged with Capacitor

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/index.html && vite build --config vite.config.mjs
scripts.test: node --test gateway/test/*.test.js cli/test/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
